boundary: Source acquisition may unpack ZIP. Held input reader selects only first (time), second (V vs reference) and fourth (first-row rpm) columns, never parses third (current) column. Validate headers, counts, monotone sweep and finiteness. Before numerical source outcomes freeze pipeline and all role rules. candidate: Residual correction: at each target command voltage, evaluate all FIVE full-equation source residual curves, interpolating recorded duplicate voltages by mean then endpoint-clamped linear interpolation to that voltage. Add the residual obtained by nearest two bracketing source speeds in sqrt(rpm); outer target extrapolates from nearest two endpoints. This is a predictive correction to the physical forward map integrating shared electrode and speed-dependent mismatch; no separate physical component inference.
baseline: Direct transfer of authenticated notebook equations with five fitted unknowns (D, logk, alpha, Rs, jchg). Local SciPy optimizer is a new source-only realization, not Wolfram NonlinearModelFit. Area π*.25² cm², fixed initial metal estimates, 25°C, 13.9918 pKw. Estimate on source measurements only (all points stratified by source rows using up to 100 uniform indices per file); unsmoothed unweighted robust-free squared measured current-density errors at applied potential, stable fitted bounded least-squares. score: Every finite recorded held row at actual supplied voltage, including low-current onset. Per-sweep RMSE and MAE in A/cm²; arithmetic mean across 6 sweeps, disaggregate both held speeds and 3 metals. Primary corrected vs every listed control mean RMSE and at least 4/6 vs strongest aggregate competitor, plus lower mean RMSE on both held speeds vs uncorrected physics. No trimming or current-defined scoring. Report exact row coverage, nested dependence, whole worst raw row and all same-row controls; no mechanistic identifiability, independent electrode replication or causal-assignment claim.
